XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine fault light comes on, impossible to regenerate the particulate filter
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | FAULTS | MIL | FAP | DPF | P0471-00 | P2453-00 | P2456-00 | P154B-00 | REGENERATE | BLOCKED | SENSOR | PRESSURE | DIFFERENTIAL |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Differential pressure sensor

  • Fault: Engine fault light illuminated; unable to perform particulate filter regeneration

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system:
    • P0471-00: Exhaust gas pressure sensor 1 – incorrect signal
    • P154B-00: Particulate filter differential pressure sensor 1 – fault
    • P2453-00: Particulate filter differential pressure sensor 1 – incorrect signal
    • P2456-00: Particulate filter differential pressure sensor 1 – irregular signal
  • Cause: Differential pressure sensor malfunction

• Action: Proceed with replacement of differential pressure sensor
